problem: An existing free selfscan and a brochure offer value, but the open-loop commercial day is still degraded with no proven paid orders. Outreach needs an explicit first-value offer that does not trade a simulated ROI claim or gated download for fake conversion.
root_cause: Visitors can discover the free scan, but the reciprocal, transferable seven-leak worksheet and a distinct evidence-based offer ladder are not made explicit across the existing public scan and product-led growth rule.
fix: Add one ungated four-page ASCII-valid PDF lead magnet and first-party landing route; link it to the existing selfscan without altering the canonical selfscan or its static i18n cache and define one canonical Cialdini, lead qualification, sales tracking and learning rule in the existing Powerhouse product-led skill.
prevention: Give genuine customer value before an ask; don't demand contact details for an ungated PDF.
Distinguish modeled cost from realized revenue; require actual order/payment evidence to count conversion.
Use existing one Brain, Heartbeat, commercial scoring, CRM, SalesRobot UUID and attribution rather than another sender or scheduler.
Use truthful Cialdini: no invented social proof, authority, deadlines, inventory or risk scores.
The user need not share personal/business data to receive the PDF; optional future outreach requires proper legal basis.
No duplicate sales messages or repeat publications for an already fulfilled channel/day/recipient.
outcome: A no-gate PDF and offer ladder are added as a candidate. No direct revenue, booked calls, live distribution or verified learning has been established by creating these files.

invariants: realized-revenue is not PDF download or provider ACK
no duplicate sends or standalone executor
build/deploy/production readback before public launch claim
productionCriteria: new PDF returns application/pdf and opens 4 pages
real GA/CRM funnel event readback, no pseudo events
real paid order linked back to Brain
customer outcome and changed next action when evidence exists
